matches.tactical_summary: Ivory Coast adopted a direct approach, capitalizing on early pressure and individual brilliance from Pépé to secure their goals. Curaçao, despite defensive resilience, struggled to create significant attacking threats against a well-organized Ivorian defense throughout the match.

narrative: Ivory Coast secured a historic qualification for the knockout stages of the World Cup for the first time, thanks to a brace from Nicolas Pépé against Curaçao. Curaçao's debut World Cup campaign ended with their elimination, despite a valiant effort in the group stage.
